title: Very disappointed.
text: Very disappointed.. I enjoy my culinary skills. I bake and cook a lot. I bought this set because of the reviews. I  had two 2 cup Pyrex cups that chipped at the pouring angle.  They lasted for years but were very heavy.  I tried this set because of reviews and being lighter in weight. I just threw out the last one because it leaked at the joint on the bottom of the cup. The other two cracked from the center bottom then leaked. They did not wash well…got cloudy and never looked clean again. VERY DISAPPOINTING to a person who actually uses measuring cups a lot.

product_metadata.title: Vremi 3 Piece Plastic Measuring Cups Set - BPA Free Liquid Nesting Stackable Measuring Cups with Spout and Decorative Red Blue and Green Handles - includes 1, 2 and 4 Cup with Ml and Oz Measurement

Each lightweight and heat resistant measuring cup features an ergonomic, non-slip, silicone handle in red, blue or green for excellent control while pouring of water, cooking oil, vinegar and EVOO – all with no spills

Each durable measuring pitcher cup is printed with cup and ounce labels on one side, while the reverse has a metric scale in milliliters. With easy-to-read black markings that contrast nicely for easier and accurate measuring

Our angled measuring cup set is designed with non-drip, slanted, lipped spouts for accuracy and convenience for no-spill ease, and the cups are stackable for space saving storage. This means our cups are the perfect solution to tidying up an already cluttered kitchen, cutting out spills and clutter

These cute and decorative multi-sized cups for professional or everyday use can make you the chef you want to be. Our cups are durable for hot or cold liquids, and can store food in advance. From near-frozen treats to hot liquids up to 175°F, our cups can do it all. Hand wash only to preserve the hard plastic quality
